name: Dimmer Keypad, 6 Buttons

steps.text: At the electrical panel, turn off the circuit breakers or remove the fuses feeding the wall box, and make sure the power is off.
Remove the wall plate from the switch, unscrew the switch and gently pull it out.
Disconnect the wires from the switch.
Turn on power.
Use a voltage meter to identify the line and load wires that were connected to the switch, and identify the neutral and ground wires.
Turn off power.
Connect the keypad's bare copper wire to ground, white to neutral, red to load and black to line. Make sure the connections are firm with no exposed wire.
With the button labels right side up, gently place the keypad into the wall box and screw it into place.
Turn on power.
steps.expect: The LED of the ON button and the connected light turn on.

steps.text: Tap the ON button on and off to check that the keypad works.
steps.expect: The button LED and the load turn on and off.

steps.text: Reinstall the wall plate.

notes: In 3-way and 4-way circuits every switch must be replaced by an Insteon keypad or switch. Wire one to line, neutral and load and the others to line and neutral, using one traveler to share line between boxes and capping the unused traveler and the red wire on keypads without the load. Then add them to a scene as controllers and responders of each other.

steps.text: Tap the keypad button that will control the scene. Use the ON button for the main scene.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps, about 3 seconds.
steps.expect: beep; the scene button's LED blinks

notes: As a controller: after the keypad beeps, set the responder to the state the scene should recall and press and hold its SET button until it double-beeps or its LED flashes. The keypad double-beeps and its LED stops blinking.

As a responder: press and hold the controller's scene button until it beeps, tap the keypad button that should respond until its LED is in the desired state (press and hold to add the main scene at a dimmed level), then press and hold the keypad's SET button until it double-beeps. The button's LED flashes once and returns to its previous state.
For synchronized scenes, such as a 3-way circuit, link the devices as controllers and responders of each other.
If either LED keeps blinking, the addition failed; tap that device's SET button until the LED stops blinking and try again.

steps.text: Tap the scene button on the keypad.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps.
steps.expect: scene button LED blinks; all lit LEDs brighten to 100%

steps.text: Tap the SET button.
For each responder, adjust it to the desired scene state (on a keypad, tap the button at least once), then press and hold its SET button until it beeps or its LED flashes.
After adding all responders, tap the SET button.
steps.expect: scene button LED stops blinking; LEDs return to normal brightness

steps.text: Tap the scene button on the keypad.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps.
Press and hold the SET button again until it beeps again.
Press and hold the responder's SET button until it double-beeps or its LED blinks.
steps.expect: The keypad double-beeps and the scene button LED stops blinking.

notes: To remove a keypad button as a responder: press and hold the controller's scene button until it beeps, press and hold it again until it beeps again, tap the keypad button to remove, then press and hold the keypad's SET button until it double-beeps.

To remove several responders at once: tap the scene button, hold the SET button until it beeps, hold it again until it beeps again, then tap it; on each responder (tap the button first on a keypad) hold the SET button until it beeps or its LED flashes; tap the keypad's SET button to finish.

steps.text: Pull the SET button out to create an air gap.
Wait 10 seconds.
Push the SET button in and hold it in.
Release the SET button.
steps.expect: After a couple of seconds the keypad double-beeps, the LEDs return to normal brightness and the load turns on.

steps.text: Remove the keypad's scene memberships from all of its responders.
Remove the keypad's scene memberships from all of its controllers.
Remove the keypad from use.

notes: Otherwise delays, error blinks and repeated retries result.
Each button other than the load's can be set to toggle, send only off, or send only on.
Group 1 is the On and Off buttons, which control the load. In the 8-button layout, which software can set, groups 1 to 8 are buttons A to H.
Group 9 controls the load only while it's detached from group 1.
sources: Dimmer Keypad, 6 Buttons 2486DWH6 Quick Start Guide
